description: This file implements a workaround for the texelFetchOffset translation issue in shader compilation, involving AST traversal and node replacement.

classes.name: Traverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that searches for texelFetchOffset calls and applies a workaround.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the traversal and transformation on the AST.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares for the next traversal iteration.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits AST aggregate nodes to identify texelFetchOffset calls.

methods.name: RewriteTexelFetchOffset
methods.description: Main function to perform the rewrite if shader version is >= 300.
